notes: Prerelease 3.0.0-beta.9 is a test version of Printer Bot 3.0 and it can have mistakes. It needs no new import. New: Images in messages. In the dock, switch on the image sites you accept (Imgur, Catbox, ImgBB). A link in a viewer's message to a picture on one of those sites then prints as that picture, up to three to a message. Every site is off until you switch it on, and a link from a site that is off stays text. Each printer has a switch, Allow images. Printer Bot loads the picture from the site when the message prints, so the site sees this PC's address, and it does not look at what the picture shows. The hidden receipt browser is started again once after the update, so that it can reach the sites. Reload the dock after the update.
